title: Excel for Data Analysis
tagline: Unlock Excel's full potential -- From basic spreadsheets to advanced business intelligence and data modeling.
overview: This course transforms you from an Excel beginner to an advanced data analyst. You'll learn to harness Excel's powerful features for data cleaning, analysis, and visualization.

Through practical exercises and business case studies, you'll master pivot tables, advanced formulas, Power Query, and dashboard creation. The course focuses on real-world applications, preparing you to solve complex business problems efficiently using Excel.
learningOutcomes: Master advanced Excel formulas and functions (VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, etc.)
Create dynamic reports using PivotTables and PivotCharts
Clean and transform data using Power Query
Build interactive dashboards with slicers and timelines
Perform what-if analysis with Data Tables and Scenario Manager
Automate tasks using Macros and VBA basics
Create compelling data visualizations and charts
Use Power Pivot for data modeling and DAX formulas

targetAudience.title: Business Professionals
